name: National Biomedical
old_description: National Biomedical provides Repairs, Inspection, and Preventative Maintenance to various Medical Equipment.
about:
National Biomedical operates from Manchester, New Hampshire, serving clients across New England. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company provides biomedical equipment services including preventative maintenance performed to manufacturer guidelines, onsite repair for most medical equipment, inspections adhering to NFPA 99 and NFPA 101 standards, dental equipment repair, equipment service history management via dedicated software, and certification documentation for regulatory compliance.

Its customer base includes healthcare facilities, dental practices, and other medical equipment operators throughout New England. The company emphasizes onsite service for most repairs and maintains detailed service records for each piece of equipment.

National Biomedical states its mission is to deliver best-in-class service while meeting regulatory standards cost-efficiently. It differentiates itself through professional, insured technicians, transparent pricing with no hidden costs, warranty on repairs, emergency service availability, guaranteed work, fast turnaround, highly trained staff, and free estimates.
